FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 218
Committee: Veterans, Military Affairs, and Sponsor: Senator Keith Kelley
Public Safety
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/09/2026
Senate Bill 218 as introduced would increase motor vehicle registration and license fee receipts
to the Alabama Law Enforcement Agency (ALEA), the Public Road and Bridge Fund, and the
counties and municipalities by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of off-road
or recreational off-road vehicles that would become registered pursuant to the provisions of this
bill.
Additionally, this bill would also increase the administrative obligations of: (1) the Department
of Revenue to administer the provisions of this bill; and ALEA to collect certain accident data
on off-road vehicles and report to the Joint Transportation Committee of the Legislature prior to
the start of the 2029 legislative session.
